name: Kit Builder
notes: v0.3.0 adds engine-v2 (Batch E): automatic loudness matching (peak-window RMS, attenuate-only per-pad makeup gain via the RANDOM-page "Match Levels" action) and an audition step sequencer (internal 16-step clock at Move tempo, Rec = edit view, Play = run, one 16-bit lane per pad, transient). Also includes the unreleased 0.2.0 line: EXPORT page + MrDrums .ablpreset and MPC .xpm export (samples gathered beside the .xpm), scan-time loop/size filters, WAV metadata stripping, and the Revision 3 category/pad model (22 categories, config.pad_layout union pools, filename-fallback classification). schwung-manager reads version + download_url.
